visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are positioned on a vibrant green and blue electric scooter; the driver wears a light blue uniform, a black tactical vest, and grey bunny ears, while the passenger wears a pink floral shirt and fox ears. They are in a paved residential driveway with a grey metal gate and tan-colored brick buildings in the background under flat, natural daylight. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up of the woman in bunny ears, who is smiling broadly and gesturing with her hands toward the camera. She is standing outdoors in a city area with a grey slated fence and green foliage visible in the shallow depth of field. (3) A digital interface overlay appears on screen showing two selection buttons labeled 'YouBike' and 'WeMo'; a finger taps the WeMo icon. Then, a smartphone screen is shown in a close-up, displaying a map application with a cartoon fox head icon located near the center. (4) The women are seen riding the electric scooter through bright city streets; they both wear white safety helmets. The camera follows from a side angle, showing them passing urban storefronts and street signs under clear sunny conditions. (5) They arrive at a themed plaza featuring a tall, white Christmas tree decorated with colorful ornaments and Disney Zootopia character cutouts. They pose dynamically, making 'peace' signs and smiling, with various large gift boxes and character statues scattered around the paved ground. (6) A montage of movie trailer footage shows high-quality 3D animation of various animal characters: a sloth driving a car, a fox and rabbit in a forest at night, and an elephant-sized shrew sitting in a tiny armchair. The lighting in these scenes varies from bright interior lights to cinematic night-time outdoors with purple and blue hues.
